text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I want Mejiro Ramonu to master medium-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those expectations are the Oaks, the Shuka Sho,
the Takarazuka Kinen, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That faith was rewarded with brilliant victories in the Japan Cup, Osaka Hai, and Tenno Sho (Autumn).
choice_data_list: (A great record that will go down in racing history!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I told Mejiro Ramonu about that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu runs supreme races,
and winning them is her ultimate love.
She is not fixated on records themselves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You take pride
in that."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Very?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Then,
it calls for a celebration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Could you please call over the people I'm about to name?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure...
it'll be a wonderful party...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Mmm.
Smells wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Aren't you two going to eat?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I brought some yokan as tea sweets.
You should eat them together, Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Chew your yokan thoroughly... and enjoy every delicious bite.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Then... please call
Rudolf and Sirius for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are Umamusume with deep ties
to Mejiro Ramonu. They certainly made sense
as guests for the party. However—
choice_data_list: Those two are, if I recall...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get the impression they're close...
Or rather, whenever I see them talking,
it usually feels like there's tension in the air...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.
choice_data_list: (If you put it that way, I've got no choice but to give it my all...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
It has to be the two of us together, or it won't work.

text_block_list.name: Rudolf & Sirius
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll join.
I decline.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Sirius. In the past, the three of us
even threw little parties together, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We haven't had a chance like this in years...
Wouldn't it be nice to have a three-way chat after all this time?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Outside of racing,
I've got nothing to say to you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "At this rate, I won't be able to get them both to come. Sirius Symboli has a strong-willed personality, so rather than just begging, with Mejiro Ramonu, maybe—"
choice_data_list: ...It's always a bit embarrassing talking to a childhood friend, isn't it?
...It's always a bit embarrassing talking to a childhood friend, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Heeh? Sounds like he's training her
pretty well. Interesting...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our little party of four
somehow managed to get underway, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ah,
how interesting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Hey,
Trainer?
choice_data_list: My heart is pounding like crazy...
My heart is pounding so fast...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Why?
Puppies frolicking together... Aren't they adorable?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought...
Ramonu, don't drag me into your way of killing time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
So you knew, and came anyway.
You little spoiled sweetheart... Did you feel lonely being left out?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you thought we were buddies?
Well aren't you adorable.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu... How nostalgic. To have all my old friends gathered together—what a comforting time this is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"It brings back memories. The three of us used to gather
and have picnics like this in the past, too...
Sirius and I would start running, and you—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...No, you don't remember, do you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hey, cut the farce already.
We're moving.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—You're gonna run, right?
There's only one reason you ever invite someone along.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you know about that too.
In that case...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I take it you intend to add another blossom of glory to my "grand record."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Full of confidence, are you?
I'll treat you to a taste of defeat as a housewarming gift.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I shall send flowers separately.
Giving my absolute all against you... That is my congratulations to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...I haven't forgotten.
That day, watching from the shade of the trees.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That ringing laughter... it's stuck in my ears.
Still, right now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: We can roughhouse for real.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the playful banter of the three old friends who gathered amidst their busy schedules... moved to the track and continued until evening.
